claims: The Michigan Wolverines defeated the UConn Huskies 69-63.
The game was the 2026 NCAA Men's Basketball National Championship game.
The Michigan Wolverines secured their first title since 1989.
The game was played in Indianapolis.
The halftime score was Michigan 33, UConn 29.
Elliot Cadeau led Michigan with 19 points.
Michigan shot 25 of 28 from the free-throw line.
